# Kenney Mini Dungeon player

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/mini-dungeon

Downloaded 2026-09-10, Mini Dungeon 2.0, CC0. Original terms are in License.txt.
Imported character-human.fbx and its colormap.png only. Unity material and player
controller are configured by FirstPersonDefenseSceneBuilder. No upstream scripts
or Unity packages were imported. The staff is a project-created procedural prop.
